intro.label: OUR EXPERTISE / SOCIAL MEDIA MARKETING
intro.heading: Social media marketing.
intro.description: Social media marketing services for businesses that need a consistent, practical content plan. We discuss your audience, brand voice, selected platforms, and available assets before agreeing deliverables.

offers.title: Platform & content strategy
offers.description: Choose appropriate platforms, content themes, and a posting calendar based on your audience and business priorities.

offers.title: Post design & captions
offers.description: Prepare branded post designs, captions, and hashtag research within the agreed scope. Any footage, photography, or approvals needed from you are discussed up front.

offers.title: Reporting & next steps
offers.description: Review agreed platform analytics and content performance. Use those observations to refine future content rather than promise a fixed number of followers or leads.

items.planning: Share your social profiles, target audience, brand guidelines, available images or footage, and posting priorities. We will discuss platforms, post quantities, approval workflows, reporting, and whether advertising is included.

items.title: Search Engine Optimization
items.short: Search engine optimization services covering keyword research, on-page improvements, technical reviews, and content planning. We identify priorities from your website, audience, and current search visibility.
items.description: Search engine optimization services covering keyword research, on-page improvements, technical reviews, and content planning. We identify priorities from your website, audience, and current search visibility.

intro.label: OUR EXPERTISE / SEARCH ENGINE OPTIMIZATION
intro.heading: SEO services.
intro.description: Search engine optimization services covering keyword research, on-page improvements, technical reviews, and content planning. We identify priorities from your website, audience, and current search visibility.

offers.title: Keyword research & page mapping
offers.description: Identify relevant queries and their search intent, then map them to useful service pages and content. Search volumes and competition require appropriate tools and market-specific evidence.

offers.title: On-page & technical SEO
offers.description: Review titles, descriptions, headings, internal links, crawlability, indexing directives, structured data, and mobile performance. Implementation work is agreed to your website’s needs.

offers.title: Content planning & reporting
offers.description: Plan helpful content around customer questions and review available Search Console data. Rankings and traffic depend on many factors and cannot be guaranteed.

items.planning: Share your website URL, priority services, markets, and any existing Search Console access. We will discuss audit findings, implementation scope, content responsibilities, and how progress can be measured over time.
